messages:
Sasha: hey team, noticed a cluster of inbound leads stuck as unclaimed >12m for the last 8 hours. mostly from APAC connectors. tagging @Ibrahim and @Clara to triage. link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/filter/unclaimed
Ibrahim: thanks. quick check  are these RR only? any recent changes to slot_timeout?
Clara: confirmed RR flows. slot_timeout set to 25s, ack_window 12s. enrichment calls to third-party vendor spiked latency around the same time (p95 ~ 3.8s) plus webhook retries.
Sasha: business impact: a handful are high-intent (form field "request-demo" true). we should prioritize.
HubSpot Bot: webhook errors 2024-07-10T02:14:05 - 02:19:40: 18x 502/504. ref: /ops/webhooks/2024-07-10
Ibrahim: proposed short fix: bump ack_window to 60s for APAC canary 10% and enable prewarm_enrichment for connectors with external enrichment. add fallback owner after 8m.
Clara: agree. small PR and canary. also add a Slack alert to #sales for any demo-requests unclaimed at 5m.
Sasha: owners: Ibrahim (PR + canary), Clara (HS fallback + sales notify), Sasha (monitor SLAs). i'll schedule a 15m sync after canary start.
Ibrahim: created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/leadrouter/pull/512  canary start ts 1725006840. will post results.
Sasha: perfect. rollback criteria: if pct_unclaimed_15m increases or webhook 5xx > baseline. thanks all. :thumbsup:
